QC-HOME-006 —
Upcoming Featured Event
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-006 |
US001 | REF: FR-004
Title
Upcoming Featured Event — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to see a featured upcoming Qatar Chamber event prominently
displayed on the Home Page
So that
I can quickly discover and register for the most important
upcoming event
Preconditions:
- At least one event is pinned as the featured upcoming
event in the CMS and it is published.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls to the Upcoming Event section on the Home
Page.
2. The section renders in a two-column layout: event image on
one side, event details on the other.
3. Visitor reads the event details: section tag, event title,
date, time, location, and short description.
4. Visitor clicks on event image — browser navigates to the
event detail page.
5. If no event is pinned the section does not render.
Given the
visitor scrolls to the Upcoming Event section
When the
section renders
Then
- The system shall display the pinned event details
sourced from the Events module: event image, title (bilingual), date, time,
location (bilingual), and short description (bilingual).
- Clicking it shall navigate to the event detail page.
- If no event is pinned, the Upcoming Event section shall
not render on the Home Page.
- The section shall be fully responsive on all screen
sizes.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If the pinned event's date has passed, the section
shall still display the event as pinned until the admin unpins it.
- If the pinned event is unpublished from the Events
module, the Upcoming Event section shall not appear.
Post Condition:
- The featured upcoming event is visible on the Home Page
and links to the event registration/detail page.
BACKEND — Admin CMS
Management
User Story ID
QC-HOME-006 | US002 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Upcoming Featured Event — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to pin a specific published event to appear as the
featured Upcoming Event on the Home Page
So that
visitors can prominently see the most important upcoming
event on the Home Page
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate permission to manage
Home Page content in Liferay CMS.
- The event to be pinned is already published and active
in the Events module.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Home Page → Upcoming Event Pin Configuration.
3. Opens the event selector — a list of all published events
is shown.
4. Admin selects one event to pin as the featured upcoming
event.
5. Sets the active status to enabled.
6. Saves and publishes the configuration.
7. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
8. The selected event appears as the featured Upcoming Event
on the Home Page after cache refresh.
9. To remove the featured event the admin unpins it — the
Upcoming Events section is hidden from the Home Page.
Given the admin
opens Upcoming Event pin configuration in the CMS
When the admin
selects and saves a pinned event
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to select one
published event to pin as the featured upcoming event.
- The pinned event's details (title, date, time,
location, description, image) shall be sourced automatically from the Events
module record.
- The system shall allow the admin to unpin the current
event; the Upcoming Events section shall then be hidden on the Home Page.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If no event is pinned the Upcoming Events section shall
not appear on the Home Page.
- If the pinned event is unpublished from the Events
module the section shall not appear.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the admin selects an event whose date has already
passed a warning shall display: "Warning: Selected event date has passed.
Do you still want to pin this event?" تحذير: تاريخ الفعالية المحددة قد انتهى.
هل تريد تثبيتها على أي حال؟
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied. You
do not have permission to perform this action." تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية
لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
- The selected event is pinned and displayed as the
featured Upcoming Event on the Home Page.
Note: For Section Tag, Title, Description the requirements is generic thorught the Home page.
